name: defense
label: Defense
description: Business development for defense, public safety and federal sellers: a defense pipeline with PWIN and BANT scoring, contract vehicles and solicitations, compliance fields on products and quotes, partnerships, OEM integrations, proposals, BOMs, travel, marketing materials and opportunity discovery. Details in DEFENSE_HANDOFF.md beside this manifest.

objects.description: Teaming partners, VARs, distributors and alliances
Bills of materials: a product's components (as line items), cost and target margin
Business travel: itinerary, budget and approval
Travel and business expenses, with receipts
Slick sheets, presentations, posts and event materials
Business documents, tagged by type and section
Where to look for solicitations and market intelligence
Possible opportunities waiting for review: from tender emails, alerts or by hand
Topics, competitors and tenders to follow
Red Star alerts: roadblocks on a deal that need the team now

properties.label: Product category
properties.description: Your product lines. Add your own in Settings, Properties.

properties.label: PWIN
properties.description: Probability of win, 0 to 100. The BANT Calculator sets it from the BANT total; reps may override it.

properties.label: BANT total
properties.calc_sql: case when num_nonnulls(r.bant_budget, r.bant_authority, r.bant_need, r.bant_timeline) = 0 then null else coalesce(r.bant_budget, 0) + coalesce(r.bant_authority, 0) + coalesce(r.bant_need, 0) + coalesce(r.bant_timeline, 0) end

properties.label: BANT answers
properties.description: The BANT Calculator's answers, so it can show them again.

properties.label: Weighted amount
properties.description: Amount in base currency times PWIN.
properties.calc_sql: case when r.amount_base is null or r.pwin is null then null else round(r.amount_base * r.pwin / 100, 2) end

properties.label: Rank or grade
properties.description: As printed, e.g. Col., O-6, GS-15, SES.

properties.label: Product category
properties.description: Your product lines. Add your own in Settings, Properties.

properties.label: Lead
properties.description: Who the team's members report to.

properties.label: Estimated total
properties.calc_sql: case when num_nonnulls(r.est_airfare, r.est_hotel, r.est_meals, r.est_other) = 0 then null else coalesce(r.est_airfare, 0) + coalesce(r.est_hotel, 0) + coalesce(r.est_meals, 0) + coalesce(r.est_other, 0) end

properties.label: Fit score
properties.description: Product fit from the Opportunity evaluator, 0 to 100.

properties.label: Fit risk
properties.description: Risk level from the Opportunity evaluator.

properties.label: Fit evaluation
properties.description: The Opportunity evaluator's full answer (JSON: summary, strengths, gaps, risks, recommendation).

settings.label: n8n address
settings.description: Where your n8n runs, with the four Defense CRM workflows (Opportunity evaluator, AI report, BOM reader, RFP generator). Leave blank to skip them: Opp. Evaluator, Reports, the BOM reader in Operations and the RFP Generator's AI buttons will not work until an install with the address adds them.

integrations.label: Opportunity evaluator (Claude)
integrations.description: Opp. Evaluator: a product and an RFP or requirements document (PDF as base64, or text) to Claude; answers { ok, evaluation } with a fit score, risk, strengths, gaps and next steps.

integrations.label: AI report (Claude)
integrations.description: Reports: a report type (sales_projection, pipeline_summary, win_loss, customer_segment, trade_show, bd_activity), filters, notes and the filtered pipeline to Claude; answers { ok, report }.

integrations.label: BOM reader (Claude)
integrations.description: Operations: a BOM file (PDF as base64, or CSV text) to Claude; answers { ok, bom } with parts, quantities, costs and total COGS.

integrations.label: RFP generator (Claude)
integrations.description: RFP Generator: a proposal's details, notes for the AI and an optional previous proposal to follow (PDF as base64, or text) to Claude; answers { ok, content } with the proposal draft in markdown.
